data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The fetch budget should be denominated in expected information gain, unifying all resource consumption under a single value metric; exhaustion is recorded when the cumulative information gain reaches a limit, with a typed terminal that logs the gain estimates and actual outcomes.","counterconditions":[{"case":"Information gain is subjective and hard to measure objectively, making the terminal non-auditable in a resource-accounting sense.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"It doesn't guarantee reproducibility if the gain estimates depend on the agent's internal state.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"This is a speculative covering principle that may not satisfy the requirement for a typed auditable terminal based on concrete resources.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The agent maintains an information budget (max_info).
